Extract description from <meta name='description'> tag

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"extract_metadata\":true}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<html><head><title>Page</title><meta name=\"description\" content=\"This is the page description.\"></head><body><p>Content</p></body></html>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
